Author: Manish Pitale

 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bomba
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction

 vs.

sentences.text:
Smt. M. S. Bane, Agp for
respondents-State.

On 12.11.2025, this Court had recorded the petitioner that this is a case of lapsing of acquisition under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The respondent-State was granted time till 01.12.2025 to file reply affidavit and it was specifically noted that no further time shall be granted.

2. Despite the aforesaid direction, reply affidavit has not been filed and the learned AGP is seeking further time.
3. As a matter of last chance, the respondent-State is granted further time of three weeks to file reply affidavit.
4. List for further consideration on 06.01.2026, High on Board.
Digitally signed by PRIYA PRIYA Date:
